text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When did I wander over here...? Goodness, 
I need to stop daydreaming...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I haven't paid my respects to the 
Three Goddesses yet~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today. May 
everyone spend tomorrow in good health as 
well.
